# Homeward: image prompts

Generate in this order, 16:9, as large as your tool allows (3840 x 2160 ideal, 1920 x 1080 minimum). Attach the references named under each prompt. Make four variants of every frame and keep the one whose centre third best matches its neighbour. Replace {STYLE}, {WALKER} and {REGION} with the blocks above; `node tools/art.mjs prompt K03` prints any prompt already expanded, with the files to attach.

## Prompt blocks

### STYLE

```text
Cinematic photoreal frame, large-format digital cinema look, very fine 35mm grain, soft lens falloff at the edges. Low golden-hour sun from frame left, warm key light with a cool soft fill, gentle atmospheric haze. Rich deep greens and warm earth tones (teak, terracotta, brass, saffron), a lightly painterly colour grade, high dynamic range with detail kept in the shadows. Centre-weighted composition that survives a vertical 9:16 crop. No text, no captions, no watermark, no logo.
```

### WALKER

```text
a man in his mid-30s, lean, short black hair with a little grey at the temples, short trimmed beard, warm brown skin, dark-brown eyes with a clear amber ring around the pupil, wearing an undyed linen shirt with rolled sleeves, charcoal cotton trousers and brown leather sandals, with a faded indigo cloth bag on his right shoulder
```

### REGION

```text
Hill-country village architecture: whitewashed clay walls, heavy carved teak doors and pillars, a deep timber veranda, terracotta tile roof with wide eaves, handwoven wool and cotton rugs, brass lamps, clay pots, woven baskets. Replace this paragraph with your own region and every prompt follows.
```

### NEGATIVE

```text
text, letters, captions, subtitles, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted or cross-eyed eyes, duplicated limbs, face morphing, background morphing, jump cut, flicker, cartoon, plastic skin, oversaturated, HDR halos, lens-flare blobs, cars, power lines, modern objects
```

### K04 · The eye (closes c02)

Attach: A0, K03.

```text
{STYLE} Extreme macro of the man's left eye filling the frame: dark-brown iris with a clear amber ring and fine radial fibres, a sharp round black pupil placed at the exact centre of the image, upper lashes, a little skin texture at the edges. The cornea holds a tiny sharp reflection of a bright green valley with a single house on a hill. Shallow depth of field, soft golden light from the left.
```

The pupil must sit at the exact centre: the portal join opens from this point.

**Before you move on, check each pair:** the eye colour and amber ring match from A0 to K04; the pupil (K04), the house (K05) and the doorway (K06) sit at the exact centre; the horizon height and sun position match between K09 and K10; the light comes from the left in every frame. Page text will be gibberish, which is fine as texture; docs/CHECKS.md says what to do if a line must be readable.
